caption:
Today is a Snake day 🐍 Pause on your animal.

Every day has an animal. Today's Snake meets the animal of the year you were born: Monkey gets a best-friend day, Ox and Rooster a team day, Pig a clash day. Born in Jan or early Feb? Use the animal before yours.

Your animal is your Season. The element of the day you were born is your Sky. Find both free at the link in bio.

Which animal are you? Comment below.

day_line: Rain and mist on a Snake day. Calm and wise: good for rest, reading and quiet talks, easy to overthink.
